newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended a shortened session slightly lower before a holiday on Thursday.
One trader described the market with "almost no turnover. We had very very small volume," he said.
As expected, the Swiss National Bank (SNB) left interest rates unchanged at its weekly meeting, which was moved ahead to Wednesday due to Thursday's holiday.
Swiss markets will be closed on Thursday for Ascension Day.
Swiss unemployment data for will be released Friday morning at roughly 0600 GMT.
Euro Swiss francs down four at 98.12.
